verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents its own background mechanisms. SQL alert rules evaluate on a set interval and fire Slack or HTTP webhook destinations without user involvement (docs-21, docs-22). Refreshable materialized views recompute on a schedule (docs-34), and large SQL operations run as background batches of retryable tasks (docs-15). These are narrow, database-scoped automations rather than a general automation or agent-scheduling feature, and none of them is shown as agent-driven. Missing for 10: a general-purpose scheduled job or workflow automation feature, autonomous agent-driven background runs, trigger-to-action automations beyond alerting, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
